description: Remove another user from a thread by user ID. Needs Manage Threads, or being the creator of a private thread; the thread must not be archived. To have the bot leave a thread instead, use discord_leave_thread; to add someone to a thread, use discord_add_thread_member. Bot permissions it may need: Manage Threads. Destructive: the user is asked to approve the exact change before it runs.

channel_id.description: ID of the thread to remove the member from

user_id.description: ID of the user to remove from the thread
